حَضِرٌ One who intrudes uninvited at feasts; a smell-feast; a spunger; (TA;) one who watches for the time of (يَتَحَيَّنُ) the feeding of others, in order that he may attend it; as also ↓ حَضُرٌ , (K,) and ↓ حُضُرٌ . (IAar, K, TA.) ＝
-A2- A man unfit for journeying: (T, S:) or one who does not desire journeying: or i. q. حَضَرِىٌّ. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
